definitions.explanation: The act of doing something to pass idle time, or an activity done for that purpose. Can have a slightly casual or self-deprecating nuance.

examples.japanese: {暇|ひま}つぶし⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ゲーム→ゲーム：03842_geemu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I played games to kill time.

examples.japanese: {暇|ひま}つぶし⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{本屋|ほんや}→本屋：03034_honya⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦ぶらぶら→ぶらぶら：05167_burabura⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I wandered around the bookstore to pass the time.

examples.japanese: ⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{暇|ひま}つぶし⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦スマホ→スマホ：04721_sumaho⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{動画|どうが}→動画：04443_douga⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: I often watch videos on my phone to kill time on the train.

notes:
USAGE:
A common casual expression. Can be used both as a noun ({暇|ひま}つぶし⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ = to do something to kill time) and as a descriptive phrase. The kanji form ⟦{暇潰|ひまつぶ}し→暇潰し：10606_himatsubushi⟧ also exists but is less common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {暇|ひま}つぶし⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧〜⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to do ~ to kill time)
- ⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧{暇|ひま}つぶし⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ (to be a good way to kill time)
- {暇|ひま}つぶし⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{方法|ほうほう}→方法：03621_houhou⟧ (ways to pass the time)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧つぶし: killing time — a synonym with identical meaning
- ⟦{娯楽|ごらく}→娯楽：00074_goraku⟧: entertainment, amusement — a more elevated term for leisure activities
